name: SummerRidge Plaza
summary: SummerRidge Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in Victorville, California, professionally managed by Investment Concepts Inc., an established real estate company with nearly 60 years of experience. The center serves the local High Desert community with convenient retail and service options.
demographics: SummerRidge Plaza serves the Victorville community in the High Desert region of San Bernardino County, attracting a diverse mix of working families and middle-income households. The trade area draws from a growing suburban population with median household incomes typical of the Inland Empire region, including young families, military personnel from nearby George Air Force Base, and commuters. Shoppers in this area prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday services and neighborhood retail options within close proximity to residential areas.
description: SummerRidge Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located at 15356 La Paz Drive in Victorville, California, strategically positioned to serve the growing High Desert community. Owned and managed by Investment Concepts Inc., a premier Orange County-based real estate development and property management company with nearly 60 years of experience, the plaza benefits from professional oversight by an IREM-certified AMO organization. Investment Concepts Inc. has built a flawless reputation throughout Southern California, Nevada, Oregon, and Arizona as one of the region's most trusted and reliable property management companies. The center provides convenient access to retail and services for local residents, maintaining the high standards of quality and functionality that Investment Concepts Inc. brings to all its commercial properties. With a solid 4.5-star rating, SummerRidge Plaza exemplifies the company's mission to create high-quality, functional developments that deliver long-term value for tenants and partners alike.
